description: Benchmark task (docs/benchmark_rules.md). RobustAnalog folded-cascode OTA with CS output stage (Shi et al., arXiv 2207.06412, Fig. 3 right), gpdk180, CL = 1 pF per output, after the curator's rewiring of the bias generator and the CM amplifier (B2). A sizing-method paper: the targets are its printed requirements (power <= 1 mW, ugb >= 30 MHz, phase margin >= 60 deg, (noise <= 30 'mV' not targeted: undefined quantity and unit, G6 step 4) gain >= 60 dB, CMRR >= 80 dB, PSRR >= 80 dB) with the 10 % tolerance, at every one of the paper's 20 PVT corners (TT/SS/FF/FS/SF x 1.6/1.8 V x 0/100 C). CMRR/PSRR from the Monte Carlo mismatch mean at the nominal condition (TT, 1.8 V, 0 C, the first corner). No objective.

source.title: Shi, Wang, Gu, Liu, Pan, Han, Sun: RobustAnalog: Fast Variation-Aware Analog Circuit Design Via Multi-task RL (arXiv 2207.06412v1; folded-cascode OTA benchmark, Fig. 3 right drawing)
source.figure: Fig. 3 (p. 5) Folded-Cascode OTA (NMOS-input folded cascode, PMOS common-source output stage, Miller-type caps to the NMOS cascode sources, bias block, CM amplifier); requirements p. 6 Sec. 4.1

supply_V.provenance: paper: p. 6 (corners 1.6 V and 1.8 V; gpdk180 nominal 1.8 V)

supply_negative_V.provenance: paper: single supply (Fig. 3: VDD and ground)

input_common_mode_V.provenance: benchmark_default_unreviewed (owner Q5b): midpoint of the simulated input common-mode range at the nominal condition (all devices saturated from ~0.6 V to the 1.8 V rail), absolute

output_common_mode_V.provenance: benchmark_default_unreviewed (owner Q5): VCM_REF chosen by simulation at the middle of the range where both stages stay saturated (VCM_REF 0.3-1.1 V, output CM 0.2-1.0 V; 0.7 V gives output CM ~0.6 V)

load_capacitance_F.provenance: benchmark_default_unreviewed (owner Q4a): 1 pF per output; the paper states no load (30 MHz at <= 1 mW implies a pF-class load)

constraints.name: quiescent_power_W
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: paper: p. 6 Sec. 4.1 (Folded-Cascode OTA constraint set C; 20 corners TT/SS/FF/FS/SF x 1.6/1.8 V x 0/100 C): power p <= 1 mW at every corner (X4: printed requirement with the 10 % tolerance)

constraints.name: unity_gain_frequency_Hz
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: paper: p. 6 Sec. 4.1 (Folded-Cascode OTA constraint set C; 20 corners TT/SS/FF/FS/SF x 1.6/1.8 V x 0/100 C): unity-gain bandwidth ugb >= 30 MHz at every corner

constraints.name: phase_margin_deg
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: paper: p. 6 Sec. 4.1 (Folded-Cascode OTA constraint set C; 20 corners TT/SS/FF/FS/SF x 1.6/1.8 V x 0/100 C): phase margin phm >= 60 deg at every corner

constraints.name: open_loop_gain_dB
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: paper: p. 6 Sec. 4.1 (Folded-Cascode OTA constraint set C; 20 corners TT/SS/FF/FS/SF x 1.6/1.8 V x 0/100 C): gain g >= 60 dB (the text labels it 'unity gain'; read as the DC differential open-loop gain, owner Q8a)

constraints.name: cmrr_dB
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: CURATOR-SCALED 2026-10-27 from paper value 80 to the witness value 75.14 (the paper prints only requirements (no sizes); 65 designs meet every other target, worst-case Monte Carlo CMRR / PSRR- stay 2-5 dB below 80 dB after an 8 h search, a local refinement and hand sizing). paper: p. 6 Sec. 4.1 (Folded-Cascode OTA constraint set C; 20 corners TT/SS/FF/FS/SF x 1.6/1.8 V x 0/100 C): CMRR >= 80 dB; owner Q7b: DC (1 Hz point) value from the Monte Carlo mismatch samples (mean of 20), evaluated at the nominal condition only (the symmetric simulation has no CMRR)

constraints.name: psrr_pos_dB
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: paper: p. 6 Sec. 4.1 (Folded-Cascode OTA constraint set C; 20 corners TT/SS/FF/FS/SF x 1.6/1.8 V x 0/100 C): PSRR >= 80 dB (polarity not stated: both, owner Q7b), DC, Monte Carlo mean

constraints.name: psrr_neg_dB
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: CURATOR-SCALED 2026-10-27 from paper value 80 to the witness value 77.61 (the paper prints only requirements (no sizes); 65 designs meet every other target, worst-case Monte Carlo CMRR / PSRR- stay 2-5 dB below 80 dB after an 8 h search, a local refinement and hand sizing). paper: p. 6 Sec. 4.1 (Folded-Cascode OTA constraint set C; 20 corners TT/SS/FF/FS/SF x 1.6/1.8 V x 0/100 C): PSRR >= 80 dB, negative supply (VSS), DC, Monte Carlo mean

constraints.name: saturation
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: benchmark rule G8 / owner Q3c: no device out of saturation at the quiescent point of every one of the 20 corners (op_check.exclude: the bias-stack device PMOS_13)
